items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: Yeah, I went out with Clyde Beatty Circus, that was last year. I've done seven months with him and everything was real nice out there. I had my own band out there.

ctx.x: So I can't remember the scrapbook, we might go over there for a few minutes if you don't

mind if there's anything else that you think would be of interest. I'm sure there would be. But I didn't finish telling you about it from these shows all the way down up until now. Well I came back to town after getting away from the rabbit for the show. Came back home, stayed around three years and three years later I went out with the Clyde Beatty Circus. Oh yeah, you were a family. Yeah, I went out with Clyde Beatty Circus, that was last year. I've done seven months with him and everything was real nice out…
Well sure that's right, that's when Sheik was talking about that same group.
